SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total'
Which neighbouring grids did New York trade the most power with in 2023?

SELECT directly_interconnected_balancing_authority, sum(abs(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double))) AS mwh_traded FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the pharmacy acquisition cost of Lantus insulin changed year by year?

SELECT substr(effective_date, 7, 4) AS year, round(avg(try_cast(nadac_per_unit AS double)), 2) AS avg_cost_per_unit FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac WHERE ndc_description LIKE 'LANTUS%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies own or operate the most units in EPA's 2023 Clean Air Markets data?
SELECT owneroperator, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND owneroperator IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did public school students break down by race and ethnicity in 2024-25?

SELECT race_ethnicity, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(student_count AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which hospitals treated the most Medicare patients for sepsis in 2021?

Did Apple or Samsung Electronics receive more U.S. patents in 2021?

How many drug and disease pairings have reached approval?

In which states do the most workers work from home?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B08006_E017' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B08006_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_work_from_home FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b08006' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the average installed price per watt of residential solar change from 2010 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, round(avg(try_cast(total_installed_price AS double) / (try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double) * 1000)), 2) AS dollars_per_watt FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE customer_segment = 'RES' AND try_cast(total_installed_price AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double) > 0 AND substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which agencies run the most federal assistance programs?

SELECT max(try_cast(combined_rate AS double)) AS highest_rate FROM govblock_treasury.i_bonds_interest_rates

SELECT year, period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LASST060000000000003' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period = 'M04'

How many contributions from political committees to candidates were made in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.contributions_to_candidates WHERE transaction_dt LIKE '%2020'

SELECT CASE substr(ntee_cd, 1, 1) WHEN 'A' THEN 'arts and culture' WHEN 'B' THEN 'education' WHEN 'C' THEN 'environment' WHEN 'D' THEN 'animals' WHEN 'E' THEN 'health care' WHEN 'F' THEN 'mental health' WHEN 'G' THEN 'diseases' WHEN 'H' THEN 'medical research' WHEN 'I' THEN 'crime and legal' WHEN 'J' THEN 'employment' WHEN 'K' THEN 'food and agriculture' WHEN 'L' THEN 'housing' WHEN 'M' THEN 'public safety' WHEN 'N' THEN 'recreation and sports' WHEN 'O' THEN 'youth development' WHEN 'P' THEN 'human services' WHEN 'Q' THEN 'international affairs' WHEN 'R' THEN 'civil rights' WHEN 'S' THEN 'community improvement' WHEN 'T' THEN 'philanthropy' WHEN 'U' THEN 'science' WHEN 'V' THEN 'social science' WHEN 'W' THEN 'public and societal benefit' WHEN 'X' THEN 'religion' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'mutual benefit' ELSE 'unclassified' END AS field, count(*) AS organisations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of active community water systems are privately owned?

Which counties have the most private hospital jobs?
